title: Audit 10: hook that refuses a zsh path= assignment (dotfiles)
notes:
In dotfiles: the PreToolUse Bash hook beside block-spin-loops.js refuses path=, local path= and typeset path=, naming the PATH tie. The global zsh rule's first line.

From the CLAUDE.md audit, docs/workflow/claude-md-audit.md (card fad098f2). The rule stays in CLAUDE.md until card 13 deletes it.

comments.body: Shipped as naeemba/dotfiles#73 (open, ready, not merged). block-spin-loops.js is renamed guard-bash-commands.js: one process runs a list of guards. The new guard refuses path=, path+=, local/typeset/declare/export/readonly/integer path=, and for/select path in at command start, skipping heredoc bodies; the refusal says zsh ties path to PATH. After merging, re-run ./install.sh so ~/.claude/scripts links the new file. Until then the hook points at a missing file and neither guard runs. Still allowed through: read path, getopts ab path. The audit doc row still says block-spin-loops.js; card 13 can fix that. The CLAUDE.md line is kept for card 13.
